about: HRSA's UDS edit checks that use only figures this module computes, rebuilt from the edit messages HRSA publishes with each year's UDS data. HRSA doesn't publish the checks themselves: each threshold is the one the message states, or the one that best separates the health centers HRSA flagged in 2025 (whose final published figures still equal the ones the message quotes) from those it didn't. `fit` says how well it does that. Generated by dev/uds_edits/rules.py in the openhealthcare workspace; don't edit by hand.

basis.flags: calendar year 2025 edit messages, health centers and look-alikes
